baseline.description: Measured working tree on this base commit with the Dockerfile's pinned Ubuntu 20260911T000000Z snapshot and LLVM toolchain. Refreshed after VxPlanningService became full-only: authoring is not an inference-profile surface, so the inference proto projection dropped from 220 to 143 messages and 78 to 68 RPCs. That removed the generated codec for those messages plus vx_api_planning.c from the inference parent, and left the RPC-only half of public_api_planning.inc without callers, which wasm-ld's default section GC then collected. Inference WASM imports clock, entropy and Synurang wakeup (3 imports, 143 exports); full also imports the device bridge (14 imports, 239 exports) and is unchanged by this work. The full-profile growth over the previous baseline comes from the in-flight buffer and tensor API work in this tree, not from the profile boundary change. Policy remains 0.5% / 8192 bytes. Native CLI baselines are refreshed from the same tree: volvoxai-lite shrank with the smaller inference codec, and volvoxai grew with the in-flight buffer and tensor API work, as the web full artifacts did. The shared and static library baselines are not tracked here. See docs/c-runtime-validation.md for validation coverage.
